title: LiveChatButtonSkill - Data API
description: Represents all the skills available to a LiveChatButton except the one currently assigned. To retrieve the skill currently assigned, query LiveChatButton. This object is available in API version 25.0 and later.

ButtonID.description: The record ID of the button.

SkillID.description: The record ID of the skill.

usage:
Use this object to assign a specific skill to a specific button for multi-skill routing. For example:

"button_Id"

myButtonDevName

"button_DeveloperName"

//Get one skill ID from button

LiveChatButton

LiveChatButton

DeveloperName

myButtonDevName

//Get remaining skills from LiveChatButtonSkill join object

LiveChatButtonSkill

LiveChatButtonSkill

//Retrieve all skills into a single list

DeveloperName
